Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class WaitlistEntry

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.WaitlistEntry
public class WaitlistEntry extends Object
Represents a student's waitlist request for a specific counselor. Stored in the Firestore 'waitlist' collection.

A waitlist entry captures the student's preferred dates and time window. Resolution happens automatically when the counselor creates a slot that falls within the entry's preferences. Entries are resolved in requestedAt order (FIFO) to prevent race conditions.

Backward compatibility: old entries (created before Sprint 8) may have a reason field and status values OFFERED / BOOKED / EXPIRED instead of RESOLVED / CANCELLED. Adapters should treat OFFERED/BOOKED as RESOLVED and EXPIRED as CANCELLED when displaying legacy records.

  • Constructor Details

    • WaitlistEntry

      public WaitlistEntry()
      Required empty constructor for Firestore.

    • WaitlistEntry

      public WaitlistEntry(String studentId, String counselorId, List<String> preferredDates, String startTime, String endTime, String note, String assessmentId)
      Creates an active waitlist entry with scheduling preferences.
      Parameters:
      studentId - Firebase Auth UID of the requesting student.
      counselorId - Counselor identifier the student wants to see.
      preferredDates - List of ISO date strings ("yyyy-MM-dd") the student is available on.
      startTime - Start of preferred time window ("HH:mm").
      endTime - End of preferred time window ("HH:mm").
      note - Optional free-text note from the student to the counselor.
      assessmentId - Optional intake assessment ID that led to this request.

    • WaitlistEntry

      public WaitlistEntry(String studentId, String counselorId, String assessmentId, String reason)
      Legacy constructor for simple entries without scheduling preferences. Retained for callers that have not yet migrated to the preference-based form.
      Parameters:
      studentId - Firebase Auth UID.
      counselorId - Counselor identifier.
      assessmentId - Optional intake assessment ID.
      reason - Human-readable reason string.
